senses.gloss: (b. h.) to split, separate; to remove; to search; v. פֶּלֶא, פְּלִיאָה.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 18</cite> <he>א־נה נִפְלֵאת וכ׳</he> it (the Law) is not hidden, as it is said (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 30:11">Deut. XXX, 11</cite>) &c.; <he>לא נִפְלֵאת אלא ממך וכ׳</he> it is hidden from thee only (through thy own fault), who didst not take pains to study it. V. <cite ref="N01060"><he>נִפְלָא</he> III</cite>

senses.gloss: to distinguish, speak distinctly, clearly; esp. (sub. נֶדֶר) to utter a distinct vow (with ref. to Num. VI, 2).
units: <cite ref="Nazir 62a:2">Naz. 62ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>יודע להַפְלוֹת</he>, <he>לַפְלוֹת</he> (from <cite ref="Q00959"><he>פָּלָה</he></cite>) who knows how to express a vow (is conscious of its bearings); <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 22">Sifré Num. 22</cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of פֶּלֶא) to do strange, wonderful things.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 60b:2">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>מַפְלִיא לעשות</he> who does wonderful things.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:19">Tosef. Ab. Zar. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:19">IV</cite>), 19 <he>מפליא ויצא</he> ed. Zuck., missing in ed., a corrupt gloss for <he>מפליא ליצנותא</he>, v. <cite ref="L00518"><he>לֵיצָנוּתָא</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 3:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. III</cite> <he>ואין מי שיַפְלִיא אחריהן</he> and none questions the correctness of their decision; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 151">Yalk. Sam. 151</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21">Num. R. s. 21</cite> <he>וה׳ ממנו</he> and he (Moses) could not decide it.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21:12">Ib.</cite> <he>שה׳ מן משה שיש צדיקים וכ׳</he> Moses was unable to decide, because many a righteous man prides himself …, and the Lord weakens his power (as a punishment).—Part. pass. <cite ref="M00564"><he>מוּפְלָא</he></cite> q. v.
